asr_text: This episode looks at personalized news feeds and how they shape a reader’s daily news. They may make it easier to find useful stories, while also raising questions about what a reader does not see and who sets those limits. By the end, you will have a clearer way to think about how a feed helps people stay informed and what may be missing.
